title: Token Monitor: Free Desktop Widget for AI Token Usage Tracking
description:
Token Monitor is a free, self-hosted desktop widget that tracks token usage, costs, and limits across 30+ AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. It syncs across all your devices and gives you breakdowns by tool, model, and project.
